Reusable Agent Contexts
|-- [M] Validated conversation value: AgentContext
|   |-- Public boundary
|   |   |-- fromTrajectory / fromMessages / fromSnapshot -> validated context
|   |   |-- toSnapshot / withoutSourceFiles -> exported descriptor
|   |   `-- withMessages / resolveSources -> new context; toPiMessages -> model input
|   |-- Internal invariants
|   |   |-- Trajectory selection walks parents from throughEntryId to fromEntryId
|   |   |   `-- Reverse into conversation order; reject missing links, cycles and duplicate IDs
|   |   |-- Assistant tool calls require matching results before the next conversation message
|   |   |   `-- Reject duplicate call IDs, orphan results and unfinished calls at slice end
|   |   `-- Snapshot validation checks version, content hash and supplied source attachments
|   |-- [D] contentHash = SHA-256(canonical descriptor)
|   |   |-- version + source identity + selected entry range + ordered messages
|   |   |-- Messages contain text, source references, named sections and assistant tool calls
|   |   |   `-- Version selection: sections -> 3; otherwise source references -> 2; otherwise -> 1
|   |   |-- Object keys are sorted recursively; array order remains significant
|   |   `-- Attached sourceFiles are excluded; references inside messages remain included
|   |-- [O] Private snapshot is cloned on construction and export
|   |   `-- Message replacement and source expansion construct new values
|   `-- [C] resolveSources -> toPiMessages
|       |-- For each source reference: use attached snapshot lines, else supplied reader
|       |   |-- Identical references share one resolution promise within this operation
|       |   `-- Missing evidence -> fail; expanded source text is bounded at 16 MiB
|       |-- Replace references with text while retaining section structure; recompute hash
|       `-- Flatten sections into labeled model-visible boundaries
|           |-- Unresolved source references -> conversion fails
|           `-- Imported assistant provenance does not choose the session's model
|-- [M] Reusable library: AgentContextLibrary
|   |-- Public operations: create, read, list, update, fork, addComment, lineage
|   |-- Depends on AgentContext + saved-record schemas
|   |   `-- I/O crosses injected AgentContextRepository and optional AgentContextSources ports
|   |-- [C] create(explicit context, metadata, requestId)
|   |   |-- Plain text -> one user message
|   |   |-- Ordered constituents / sections -> capture each source constituent sequentially
|   |   |   `-- Capture requires the source adapter; section names and order are preserved
|   |   |-- Supplied snapshot -> AgentContext.fromSnapshot
|   |   `-- With source adapter: persist attachments and verify references
|   |       `-- Repository.create -> saved-agent-context-<requestId> + summary
|   |-- [D] Creation retry identity
|   |   |-- Constituent input -> hash of name, description, constituents and supplied group
|   |   |   `-- Existing receipt is checked before recapturing source content
|   |   |-- Text / snapshot input -> hash of name, description, contentHash and supplied group
|   |   `-- Same ID + same requestHash -> prior record; different requestHash -> conflict
|   |-- [C] read / list
|   |   |-- read -> repository read -> snapshot validation -> optional source resolution
|   |   |   `-- Return original snapshot and hash plus a separate resolvedSnapshot when expanded
|   |   `-- list -> summaries -> name/description filter -> newest-first sort -> page
|   |-- [C] fork(parent ID, expectedContentHash, requestId)
|   |   |-- Existing matching request receipt -> return existing fork
|   |   `-- Otherwise read parent -> require matching hash -> create a new saved ID
|   |       |-- Copy pinned snapshot; inherit description/group unless overridden
|   |       `-- Record parent ID + parent hash as lineage; leave comments on parent
|   |-- [D] Lineage report
|   |   |-- Follow parent IDs -> reverse into root-to-selected order
|   |   |-- parentMatches <- recorded parent hash compared with current parent's hash
|   |   `-- Missing ancestor or cycle -> explicit failure
|   `-- [O] Saved metadata is separate from model-visible snapshot content
|       |-- Group assignment changes metadata without changing snapshot hash
|       |-- Comment records text, timestamp and expected content hash
|       |   `-- Same comment request is idempotent; stale hash or conflicting reuse fails
|       `-- IDs are application-store-wide, independent of a canvas or chat
|-- [M] Durable record adapter: FileAgentContextRepository
|   |-- Implements repository port; keeps file naming and mutation machinery private
|   |-- read -> parse record -> verify requested ID -> validate AgentContext snapshot
|   |-- [O] Create and publish a saved record
|   |   |-- Open exclusive temporary file -> write -> sync -> close
|   |   |-- Hard-link to final ID atomically without replacing an existing record
|   |   |-- Sync directory -> read published record -> compare requestHash
|   |   `-- Remove temporary file on every exit from publication
|   `-- [O] Serialize metadata changes across processes
|       |-- Acquire per-record directory lock; retry every 10 ms for up to 5 seconds
|       |   `-- Deadline reached -> AGENT_CONTEXT_BUSY
|       |-- Read -> mutate -> validate -> write/sync temporary file -> rename -> sync directory
|       `-- Close handles and remove temporary file + acquired lock through finally blocks
|-- [M] Shared evidence adapter: FileAgentContextSources
|   |-- Public boundary: capture / read / persist / portable
|   |   `-- Depends on registered source bindings, corpus provider, Git and ImmutableRecords
|   |-- [C] capture(sourceId, relative path, inclusive line range, optional revision)
|   |   |-- Requested or bound Git revision -> resolve commit -> read pinned regular file
|   |   |   `-- Reject trees, submodules and symlinks
|   |   `-- No revision -> read current document content
|   |       |-- Git worktree content matches HEAD's file hash -> retain Git commit reference
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> hash captured source file -> store immutable snapshot
|   |-- [D] Resolved evidence text
|   |   |-- Source reference supplies sourceId, path, line bounds and pinned version
|   |   |-- Git version -> registered repository + commit + path -> file lines
|   |   |-- Snapshot version -> contentHash -> immutable source-file record
|   |   `-- File lines + validated inclusive bounds -> selected text
|   |-- [O] Adapter retains immutable snapshot blobs and a bounded Git-read cache
|   |   |-- Git reads share promises keyed by repository root + commit + path
|   |   `-- At most 16 cache entries; failed reads are evicted so later calls can retry
|   |-- [C] persist(snapshot)
|   |   |-- Validate -> store supplied attachments -> load each distinct reference
|   |   `-- Return descriptor without attachments; descriptor contentHash is preserved
|   `-- [C] portable(snapshot)
|       |-- Load selected ranges -> retain only selected lines in attached snapshot files
|       `-- Rewrite references to those file hashes -> rebuild context and recompute hash

    |-- [D] compileDiagramAgentContext(diagram)
    |   |-- Evidence originalLines + range bounds -> attached source files + pinned references
    |   |-- Binding + evidence metadata + references -> one background user message
    |   |   `-- AgentContext.fromTrajectory -> validated snapshot and contentHash

    |-- [O] Diagram carries one backing form
    |   |-- Inline snapshot for compatibility and portable exports
    |   `-- Stored form: backingRecordId + contentHash + diagram/revision/fingerprint identity
    |       `-- store.put(snapshot) -> replace inline payload with compact reference
    `-- [C] loadDiagramAgentContext
        |-- Validate descriptor -> use inline snapshot or store.get(backingRecordId)
        |-- Validate snapshot hash, agentType='diagram-context' and matching diagram ID
